human_readable_condition: Beneficiary must be at least 18 years old on the date of registration.
Applicant must be engaged in one of the 18 listed family-based traditional trades (e.g. carpenter, mason, tailor, cobbler, goldsmith, potter, barber, washerman, etc.).
Applicant must be working in the unorganised sector or on a self-employment basis.
Applicant must not have availed a loan under a similar self-employment/business-development credit scheme of the Central or State Government in the past 5 years.
Scheme benefit is restricted to one member per family.
A person in government service, or their family member, is not eligible.
Worker must be 16 years or older.
Worker must be 59 years or younger.
Worker must not be a member of ESIC or EPFO.
Worker should not be an income-tax payee (no income threshold otherwise applies).
